feature: Raw Rust addresses and integer casts of proven array places

breadth.scope: Exact AST reconstruction of new raw-array address arithmetic and array-to-integer decay. Places, indices, integer contexts, existing casts, calls and surrounding AST remain identical. New byte scales and pointer targets are recorded, not inferred from old AST. This does not prove whole-program native equivalence or arbitrary field-base validity.
limitations: Whole-program native equivalence and full runtime type correctness are not established by structural comparison.
New byte scales and result pointer types are recorded; the previous AST cannot prove these quantities. They come directly from the PTRADD IR.
Array field projection still requires valid containing storage; arbitrary null/dangling bases are not covered.
Unresolved global/local array forms and load/store access bounds are outside this change.
Raw inherited parser failures retain diagnostics; identifier-only normalization is review-only.
Registered native proof is x86_64 with Rust overflow-checks=off and C-fwrapv. No multiarchitecture native parity claim.
